name: Sony Xperia 10 III (XQ-BT52)
_comment: Shipped device profile (docs/DEVICE-PROFILES.md). A key in your own override-hal.json replaces the same key here.
_why: On this port the camera driver dies at the first frame as soon as a JPEG stream and a RAW16 stream are in the same session, on both cameras (31 Oct - 2 Nov 2026: JPEG 4000x3000 + preview ok; the same + RAW16 4032x3016 -> device error; JPEG 640x480 + RAW16 -> device error too, so not a matter of size). ProCam 1.3.1 captures RAW16 4032x3016 on this phone with a session of viewfinder + RAW and no JPEG stream (its logs, 1 Nov 2026): the driver takes JPEG or RAW, not both at once. Hence "streams": "exclusive": the app opens the session for the chosen type and reopens it when the type changes.
_match_note: By model only: the Xperia 10 II has the same sensor and RAW size (4032x3016) but its RAW stream works, so it must not get this profile.
